data_infos.etl_description: Fetch mp05005.xml with a browser User-Agent, resolve the 20 industry roles by semantic aliases, parse western YYYYMM periods and integer counts, preserve source dashes as missing rather than zero, check industrial/service hierarchy reconciliation, and reconcile every numeric source cell to an emitted fact. The source has no age dimension.
